title: Refraction and Snell's Law
summary: Laws of refraction, refractive index, Snell's law, and total internal reflection.
objectives: I can state the laws of refraction.
I can calculate refractive index and use Snell's law.
I can explain total internal reflection and its uses.
misconceptions: Light always bends at a boundary, even when it hits along the normal.
Refraction is a kind of reflection.
